faqs.question: Are my photos stored on Kikoo's servers?
faqs.answer: No. Kikoo does not send or store your photos and videos on its servers or in the cloud. Photos are not included in account sync, so save anything you want to keep directly to your photo library.

faqs.question: How do I buy coins and paid content?
faqs.answer: Coin packages and paid content shown in the app are purchased through Apple's in-app purchase system. You can review the price and what is included before purchase. Kikoo does not receive your card number or Apple Account password.

faqs.question: I bought coins, but they aren't showing up.
faqs.answer: Check that you are signed in to the Kikoo account linked to the purchase, then use the app's Check Purchases feature to review the transaction. If the issue continues, contact support before buying the same item again.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Kikoo
privacy.description: Kikoo does not send user images, photos, or videos to the cloud. Learn what basic account, purchase, and coin information is used to operate the service and about your privacy rights.
privacy.heading:
Your photos stay on your device.
We use only the information we need.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what Kikoo processes on your device and what information it uses to operate the service.
summary: User images, photos, and videos are not sent to or stored in the company's or its service providers' cloud.
We process only the basic information needed to operate the service, such as purchase, coin, account, and basic usage information.
We do not sell photos or use them for advertising or AI training.

sections.title: 1. Scope and contact
sections.body: This policy applies to the Kikoo Selfie Club (Kikoo) app and this website, provided by Cigncloud (the ‘Company’). For privacy questions or requests to exercise your rights, send a DM to {{contactLabel}} on Instagram.

sections.title: 2. User images, photos, and videos stay off the cloud
sections.body:
The Company does not upload, transmit, or store images, photos, videos, camera frames, previews, thumbnails, original stickers, or edited results that you capture or import to the Company's or its service providers' servers or cloud. This includes encrypted and temporary files.

Capture, face and body recognition, background removal, effects, and editing are processed on your device. Information derived from media during these processes, such as facial or body landmarks and masks, is not sent to the cloud. We do not build a facial recognition database or use media for advertising or AI training.

Camera and photo library permissions are used for capture, import, and saving that you choose. Microphone permission is used for capture features that need sound. You can change permissions in iOS Settings; features that need a permission may be unavailable if you deny it.

sections.title: 3. Basic information needed to operate the service
sections.body: Not collecting photos does not mean that we collect no information. To provide and operate the service safely, the Company processes the following information as needed:

rows.name: Account and authentication
rows.data: Account identifier, sign-in provider identifier, email if provided, authentication and account-link status
rows.purpose: Sign-in, account verification, and syncing supported service status across devices

rows.name: Purchase verification
rows.data: Apple transaction and product identifiers, transaction verification information, purchase and refund status, and the account linked to a purchase
rows.purpose: Verify purchases, prevent duplicate grants, confirm purchases, and reflect refunds

rows.name: Coins, entitlements, and rewards
rows.data: Coin balance and grant, use, and adjustment records; owned content; and challenge and reward progress summaries
rows.purpose: Grant and deduct coins, provide content entitlements, and restore rewards and service status

rows.name: Basic usage and error information
rows.data: App and OS versions, device type, app installation identifier, account identifier, feature, screen, and content usage events and settings, error status, and technical information such as IP address during connection
rows.purpose: Usage statistics, feature improvement, troubleshooting, security, and abuse prevention

rows.name: Customer support
rows.data: Instagram username and profile, messages, and app, device, or transaction information you provide
rows.purpose: Respond to questions, investigate transaction or error reports, and process privacy requests

sections.after:
Apple processes payments. The Company does not receive your full card number, financial account password, or Apple Account password. Do not attach personal photos or videos, passwords, or complete payment details to a support request.

We use Google Analytics for Firebase (GA4) for basic in-app usage statistics. Events do not include original photos, videos, audio, or facial landmarks. Statistics may be linked to an app installation identifier or account identifier, so we do not describe all statistics as anonymous. Approximate location information may be derived from an IP address. See the usage information notice under ‘Settings → Usage Information’ in the app.

sections.title: 4. External sharing and device backups
sections.body:
Saving to your photo library, using the system share sheet, or transferring between devices with a friend happens when you choose to do so. These actions do not mean the Company collects or stores your photos in its cloud.

Whether an exported photo or video is saved to iCloud Photos, a device backup, or a sharing service depends on your settings and that service's policy. Copies kept or reshared by a recipient are managed by that recipient and service.

The Company does not provide photo cloud backup and cannot restore photos from its servers if they are lost because a device is lost or the app is deleted. Export anything you want to keep to a location of your choice.

sections.title: 5. Service providers and disclosure
sections.body:
For the purposes above, the Company uses account and transaction infrastructure, Apple (sign-in, in-app purchases, and transaction verification), Google (basic usage statistics), and Instagram/Meta (customer support by Instagram DM). The website is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may process technical information such as IP addresses to operate the hosting service. This website does not install separate advertising or analytics tracking scripts.

If you contact us on Instagram, the profile information and messages you send are processed under Instagram/Meta's policies. Please use DM instead of posting account or transaction details in a public comment.

Non-media service information may be processed by service providers outside your country. Where applicable law requires a separate notice or consent, that process will be followed. Contact us using the privacy contact above with questions about a particular processing activity. User images, photos, and videos are not included in these processing activities.

We do not sell personal information or provide it for targeted advertising. If disclosure is required by law or a lawful request, it is limited to the required scope.

  • Instagram Privacy Policy ↗
  • Apple Privacy Policy ↗
  • Google Firebase Privacy and Security ↗
  • Data collection by Google Analytics ↗
  • GitHub Privacy Statement ↗

sections.title: 6. Retention and deletion
sections.body:
You can manage and delete media on your device and in your photo library. Deleting the app does not automatically delete copies you separately saved to your photo library.

Account and service information is kept for as long as needed to provide the service. When the purpose is fulfilled or a valid deletion request is processed, information is deleted or de-identified. Limited transaction and accounting records that must be kept by law, and records needed for disputes, security, or abuse prevention, may be retained separately for the required legal basis and period.

To request deletion, send a DM to {{contactLabel}} on Instagram. We will verify the requester and explain what can be deleted and what must be retained by law. Do not send a password or ID photo. Deleting an account does not delete photos from your device, photo library, or external sharing services.

sections.title: 7. Your rights and information security
sections.body:
Depending on applicable law, you may request access to, correction or deletion of, or restriction of processing of your personal information, or withdraw consent. Requests may also be made through a legal representative. A request may be limited for information needed to provide the service or retained by law; if so, we will explain why.

Where applicable law requires additional conditions, such as parental consent for processing a child's personal information, we follow those requirements. A parent or guardian may contact us with questions or request deletion of a child's personal information.

The Company uses appropriate safeguards, including access restrictions and authenticated communications. Operational information is used only for the purposes described in this policy.

sections.title: 8. Changes and contact
sections.body:
If app features or information practices change, we will update this page and its effective date. We will provide notice of changes that materially affect your rights as required by applicable law.

Privacy contact: Cigncloud · Instagram DM at {{contactLabel}}
Related information: Support · Terms of Use

support.title: Support | Kikoo
support.description: Get help with taking and saving photos, purchase verification, coins, accounts, and privacy in the Kikoo app.
support.heading:
Hit a little snag?
Kikoo is here to help.
support.intro: From photos and saving to coins, accounts, and privacy, send a DM to @kikioo_selfie_club on Instagram.
support.note: Tell us your device model, iOS version, Kikoo version, and when and how the issue happened. Please do not send personal photos or videos, passwords, or card numbers.
support.purchasesTitle: Paid, but your coins aren't showing?
purchaseSteps: Check that you are signed in to the Kikoo account linked to the purchase.
On the app's purchase screen, use ‘Check Purchases’ to verify the existing transaction and sync your balance again. This does not start a new purchase.
If the issue continues, contact us with the product name, purchase date, and Apple order number. You do not need to attach a full receipt containing personal information.
support.purchaseNote: Spent coins are not granted again, and restoring a consumable coin purchase through the store does not reissue its balance. Contact us before paying for the same item again.
support.refundBody: You can request a refund for an Apple in-app purchase through Apple's official process. Kikoo can help with delivery errors and transaction checks. Your consumer rights under applicable law remain in effect.

faqs.question: Where are my photos saved?
faqs.answer: Captured and edited media is processed on your device. Kikoo does not send photos to the Company's cloud, so export anything you want to keep to your photo library.

faqs.question: Will my photos move if I change accounts?
faqs.answer: Photos are not synced with your account. Keep copies on your device. Check supported service information, such as coins and content entitlements, with the same linked account.

faqs.question: How can I delete my account or personal information?
faqs.answer: Send a request using the privacy contact link below. After verifying your account, we will explain what can be deleted and which transaction records must be retained by law. Do not send a password or ID photo.

terms.intro: These terms apply to using Kikoo's capture, editing, challenges, coins, digital content, and related services.

sections.title: 1. Using the service and your rights
sections.body:
Cigncloud (the ‘Company’) provides Kikoo Selfie Club (Kikoo). You may use the service for lawful purposes on a device you own or are authorized to use. Please respect your own and others' photos, creations, and portrait rights.

These terms do not limit consumer rights that cannot be waived under applicable law. If separate consent or a legal representative's consent is required, the relevant law applies; using the app alone does not mean that every consent required by law has been given.

sections.title: 2. Photos and creations
sections.body:
You or the rightful owner retain rights to photos and creations you make. Do not create or share unlawful content or content that infringes another person's rights.

The Company does not send or store user images, photos, or videos in the Company's or its service providers' cloud. Photos are not included in account sync, so export anything you want to keep to your device. External sharing and iCloud Photos that you choose to use are governed by those services' policies.

sections.title: 3. Coins and digital content
sections.body:
Paid features are optional. You can review the number of coins, price, and usage conditions on the purchase or use screen. Coins are units for designated content and features in the app. Except as required by law or separately stated, they cannot be exchanged for cash, transferred, traded, or used outside the app.

Coin and entitlement records are managed separately from photos on your device. Supported balances and entitlements may sync when you sign in with the same linked account. Coins that have already been spent are not granted again, and restoring a consumable item through the store alone does not reissue it.

sections.title: 4. Purchase checks and refunds
sections.body:
Payments in the iOS app are made through Apple's in-app purchase system. Check the confirmation screen for the actual price, currency, taxes, and product contents. A purchase authorization or pending transaction is not the same as a completed purchase.

If delivery is delayed after payment, use ‘Check Purchases’ in the app or contact Support. You can request a refund through Apple's refund process. The Company also provides support needed to check transactions and resolve delivery errors.

We do not exclude every refund simply because an item is consumable. Rights under applicable law, including rights related to cancellation of a minor's contract, unauthorized payments, or defective service, take precedence. A confirmed refund or payment reversal may be reflected in a balance or entitlement based on the verified result.

sections.title: 5. Service availability and changes
sections.body: Some features may be limited by your device, operating system, network, or the status of external services. The Company performs maintenance and updates as needed for a stable service and will provide notice of material changes or discontinuation as required by applicable law. This section does not exclude rights or responsibilities protected by law.

sections.title: 6. Privacy and account deletion
sections.body: Processing of account, transaction, coin, and basic usage information is described in the Privacy Policy. You can request account deletion through Support. The Company will explain the verification process, effects on any remaining balance or entitlements, and information that must be retained by law. Deleting an account does not automatically extinguish rights such as a refund that are protected by law.

sections.title: 7. Contact
sections.body:
Questions about the service, transactions, or these terms: Cigncloud · Instagram DM at {{contactLabel}}
See Support for purchase checks and privacy request instructions.
